title: Thanksgiving 2026
summary: Thanksgiving 2026 Giving thanks to the things that power us GET TO KNOW US The power of gratitude Thanksgiving is a time to reflect on the people, experiences, and opportunities that make life meaningful. From the love and support of family and friends to personal milestones, professional growth, and the opportunity to make a positive difference in the communities where we live and work, the team at New Fortress Energy is sharing what they’re most thankful for. The people who make it all matter “This year I’m thankful for my boyfriend and our cat, Pepper, who support me every day and fill my life with laughter and love. I’m grateful to see my family and friends thriving and living happy, healthy lives. Finally, I’m so glad to have joined such a welcoming and inspiring team at NFE. Thank you to everyone who has taught me so much this year!” - Alexandra Morchower, New York City “This year, I’m especially grateful for my family, for the strength we’ve found in each other while building a life in a new country, and for the warmth with which Mexico has welcomed us. I’m also thankful for almost six meaningful years at NFE, where every success and challenge has strengthened my belief in our values, our resilience, and above all, the incredible people who make it all possible.” - Nadia A. Berrios, Mexico ”This year I’m especially thankful for my family, whose unconditional support reaches me even from far away, and for the opportunities at NFE that have challenged me to grow as an engineer and as a person. - Cristina Nunez, Houston “I’m thankful for my family and friends that make time to talk, visit, and do fun activities together.” - William Thomas, New York City “Every year comes with its share of challenges, lessons, highs, and lows. Through it all, I remain deeply grateful for life's blessings. I'm thankful for my beautiful family and friends, for being part of an amazing team at NFE Puerto Rico, and above all, for God's unwavering love, guidance, and provision every step of the way.” - Shakira Mosquera, Puerto Rico New beginnings & growth “This year has been one of challenges, growth, and incredibly rewarding experiences, both personally and professionally. I am especially grateful for my fiancé, family, friends, and colleagues, whose unwavering love, laughter, and support have meant so much to me throughout the year. I feel fortunate to have made so many wonderful memories, from getting engaged and prioritizing my health to traveling the world with my fiancé, sharing my favorite hot chocolate spots in the city with my younger sister, and taking my little brother to his first Knicks game. It's these moments, both big and small, that remind me how much there is to be thankful for. I'm also incredibly grateful to be part of the NFE team and to contribute to work that makes a meaningful difference in communities around the world. Having lived in the Dominican Republic when I was younger, I experienced firsthand the challenges that come with limited access to reliable electricity. That experience has given me a personal appreciation for NFE's mission and the impact our work can have on people's everyday lives. I often think about how proud my younger self would be of the person I've become and the life I've built, and I'm thankful for the role NFE has played in that journey. As I reflect on everything this year has brought, I feel an overwhelming sense of gratitude for how far I've come and optimism for all that lies ahead. I'm looking forward to making even more meaningful memories in 2027.” - Lissa Javier, New York City “I am grateful for a job that challenges me every day and for the colleagues who are part of that journey. The opportunity to learn from one another and witness the dedication and hard work of those around me is something I deeply value every day.” - Rebeca Acosta, San Juan The opportunity to make a difference ”I’m thankful for my family, my health, and the opportunities and experiences NFE has provided me with this year. Professionally, I’m grateful to be part of a great team and to work alongside amazing people who are committed to making a positive difference every day .” - Matt Havill, Houston “I feel thankful for the opportunity of being part of projects bigger than myself. At La Paz we constantly face challenges which require an innovative approach, supported by technical, economic, and practical arguments; and we are grateful of seeing the positive impact that solving them has in the local community. In my personal life, my family is my biggest, most important, and longest-lasting project; and every day I feel blessed and lucky for having them.” - Edgar Moratilla, Mexico mostrander Tue, 11/24/2026 - 10:07
